title: Practice 1: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том и Мэри играли в ___ (русский, acc. sg. f.) рулетку.
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary played a game of Russian roulette.
exercises.why: **русский → русскую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with рулетку). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension of русский (f.): русская · русской · русской · русскую · русской · русской; plural: русские · русских · русским · русские (inan.) / русских (anim.) · русскими · русских.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Посмотри на ___ (тот, acc. pl.) облака.
exercises.prompt: Look at those clouds.
exercises.why: **тот → те** (acc. pl., agreeing with облака). «тот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (pl.): те · тех · тем · те (inan.) / тех (anim.) · теми · тех.    «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Посмотрите в ___ (дверной, acc. sg. m.) глазок.
exercises.prompt: Look through the peephole.
exercises.why: **дверной → дверной** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with глазок). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of дверной (m.): дверной · дверного · дверному · дверной (inan.) / дверного (anim.) · дверным · дверном; plural: дверные · дверных · дверным · дверные (inan.) / дверных (anim.) · дверными · дверных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я понимаю ___ (ваш, acc. sg. f.) дилемму.
exercises.prompt: I understand your dilemma.
exercises.why: **ваш → вашу** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with дилемму). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. Ending -а → -у.  Declension of ваш (f.): ваша · вашей · вашей · вашу · вашей · вашей; plural: ваши · ваших · вашим · ваши (inan.) / ваших (anim.) · вашими · ваших.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сколько команд перейдут в ___ (низкий, acc. sg. f.) лигу?
